articles.summary: CNA Financial Corporation (NYSE: CNA) will report third quarter 2026 results before the market opens on Monday, November 2, 2026. The news release, earnings presentation and financial supplement will be available on CNA's website at www.cna.com via the Investor Relations section. Along with these documents CNA will post a transcript of earnings remarks, which will include commentary from the Company's Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Douglas M. Worman, and Chief Financial Officer, Scott R. Lindquist. CNA invites shareholders and analysts to submit questions for management in advance of the earnings release. Management may address some or all of these questions in the posted earnings remarks. Questions may be submitted to Ralitza.Todorova@cna.com . About CNA CNA is one of the largest U.S. commercial property and casualty insurance companies. articles.summary: Loews Corporation (NYSE: L) will report third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 2, 2026. On that date the Company will also post earnings remarks on its website. These remarks will include commentary from the Company's Chief Executive Officer, Ben Tisch, and Chief Financial Officer, Jane Wang. The news release and earnings remarks will be available online at the Loews Corporation website ( www.loews.com ). About Loews Corporation Loews Corporation is a diversified company with businesses in the insurance, energy, hospitality, and packaging industries. For more information, please visit www.loews.com . articles.summary: Boardwalk Pipelines, LP ("Boardwalk") today announced that Scott Wexler has joined the company as chief financial officer and senior vice president, corporate strategic development. In his new role, Wexler will lead Boardwalk's finance organization and help shape and execute the company's long-term growth strategy. His responsibilities will span financial planning and analysis, treasury, capital markets, financial reporting, strategic investments, business development and corporate strategy. "Scott brings a valuable combination of financial expertise, strategic insight and leadership experience that will be instrumental as we continue executing our growth strategy," said Scott Hallam, president and chief executive officer of Boardwalk Pipelines. "We have significant opportunities ahead, and we want to pursue them with discipline and a clear focus on where we can create lasting value for our customers and the business.
